claim_scope: new prospective P0 experiment; no retrospective H2/H3 completion claim
candidate_policy: RGMF GRU selected by registered gated recurrent mechanism, not ranking historical pilot or outer performance

hpo.selection: minimum inner-only equal-date normalized pinball, deterministic config-order tie break
hpo.lightgbm: 20 geometrically spaced regularization values from 0.0001 through 10000; 100 rounds
hpo.budget_policy: equal trial opportunities plus equal hard tuning seconds per family; entire paired fold blocked if either exhausts allocation; no favorable completed-trial selection

matching: exact input feature values including age/coverage/masks

preprocessing_new_only.metadata_age: log1p(nonnegative days); fixed one-day unit; no fitted 1e-8 age scaling
preprocessing_new_only.coverage_masks: fixed [0,1] semantic unit; no variance division
preprocessing_new_only.other_numeric: train-only median and standard deviation; training-constant columns mapped to zero with availability mask retained; no test-estimated scale

outages.policy: hash(protocol, track, source, first actual prospective origin, seed) generates schedule before forecasts/outcomes; mask source and all dependency descendants; rebuild ages/observed/coverage consistently; no retraining for frozen intervention

transport.groups: leave one physical asset out; no held-out label embedding or normalizer; unknown group uses pooled source-group scale

ssl.comparison: train-cutoff-only pretraining versus identical supervised downstream; no reserved or future contexts

statistics.primary: equal eligible assets within date; seed-average loss within date; equal dates
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across F2/F3 and all six component contrasts as one family; unexecuted members retained null; exploratory asset/year/seed diagnostics separately BY
statistics.F2: age-aware LightGBM minus frozen RGMF GRU on identical keys
statistics.F3: paired loss-degradation difference under frozen outages
statistics.predictive_success: positive paired normalized-pinball improvement with Holm-adjusted p<=0.05 and interval excluding zero; no guaranteed coverage/economics claim

budget.resource_policy: execution requires a separately measured and admitted bill; unspent sgqx-v3.1 allowance is not an automatic new-study allocation

required_gates: conservative cost within admitted immutable ceiling
